entries.regulatory_harmonization.audit_log: unreviewed — WO-13 item 5. Part 11 audit trail with old_data/new_data JSONB and no tenant key. Its only org-ish field is user_organization TEXT, a display string about the ACTOR. GET /api/grdhe/audit/:tableName/:recordId served it cross-tenant until 5aa07bc8e; reads are now scoped by an EXISTS probe against the AUDITED table, which is keyed. That closes the disclosure and does not key the record. Decide: tenant column, or a written exemption like audit.event_log's.

$note_on_reasons: Seven entries below carry a written classification; the rest are 'unreviewed', which is the honest state and not a category. Writing 116 justifications nobody has checked would make this file assert more than anyone knows — and a baseline that overstates its own certainty is the failure mode this repository already documents for the other 42. | 2026-09-10 (WO-1): ind_sections removed. Its only CREATE TABLE was sql/ind_data_model.sql, a file on no applier, archived to sql/_legacy/. The table is absent from a real provisioned database and always was; its only reader, server/services/indCopilot.js, queries SUPABASE rather than this pool and is quarantined (server/utils/database.js:84 records that this is deliberate). So the entry was a phantom created by a phantom creator, and the gate's stale-entry check is what surfaced it.
